mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hand syringe to complete the claw was most worthwhile: the finished motion brings the previously assembled parts together.

leastWorthwhile.text: The cup fittings were somewhat repetitive, though the second ring and longer support made the change clear.

surprise.text: I initially thought the cup fitted directly to the claw, but it fitted the output syringe instead. The plunger clip also attached to the claw rather than the syringe.

arbitrary.text: The first cup and plunger clip destinations were not clear to me from their goals alone; automatic compatibility feedback corrected both guesses.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter for the reward of seeing another mechanism assembled and moving, though text alone cannot establish how recognizable the illustrations or satisfying the physical interaction are.
